name: 01103 · Springfield, MA
findings: ZIP 01103 (Springfield) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01103 (Springfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01103 (Springfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
